answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-location: every agent proves a unique physical site by answering latency-bounded pings from a jade beacon mesh. A saffron budget caps how many identities one operator may bond, while a trellis of pairwise distance checks exposes clones sharing one spot. Colluding fakes collapse to a single coordinate, so their staked collateral is slashed, raising attacker cost from near-zero to the price of many separate leased sites.
